properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt 5.1.1 is the default password-hashing adapter: HASHING_ADAPTER defaults to bcrypt (security-config.ts:116, both docker-compose files), the adapter calls bcrypt.hash/compare (bcrypt-adapter.ts:21/25), and Dockerfile/lockfile sites are the same dependency's build/install surface. Changeable here (swap adapter default to argon2).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HS256 is the default AND only JWT algorithm: security-config.ts:90 (JWT_ALGORITHM||HS256), token.service.ts:88 verify allowlist ['HS256'], jwt-adapter.ts:21. Shared-secret MAC — key-distribution risk, not a quantum one; Grover halves HMAC-SHA256 to ~128-bit.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live cipher list for the axislab.top TLS termination (foundry-ssl.conf includes ssl.conf into the 443 server block). Every suite uses ECDHE or DHE key exchange — Shor-vulnerable; hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 needs TLS1.3-only plus a PQ-capable OpenSSL/nginx. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two faces of ECDSA: the ECDHE-ECDSA suites are permitted in the live nginx cipher list (cert-authenticated TLS), and ecdsa-sig-formatter is the transitive dependency under jsonwebtoken that formats ECDSA signatures for ES256-style JWS. Both changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Correct constant-time MAC verification: webhook HMAC signatures checked with crypto.timingSafeEqual (forwarder:120, webhook.service:274) and a secureCompare util (crypto.utils.ts:74). Good posture control; keep.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TLSv1.3 is enabled in the live ssl_protocols directive (included by the axislab.top server block). Note: TLS 1.2 is also permitted, so 'required' overstates it; and no PQ group is configured, so even TLS 1.3 here negotiates classical ECDHE.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TLSv1.2 permitted alongside 1.3 in the live nginx config; the TLS 1.2 cipher list (ssl.conf:7) is all-ECDHE/DHE, so any 1.2 negotiation is harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure. Dropping TLSv1.2 is the precondition for PQ-only groups.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDHE-ECDSA and ECDHE-RSA suites head the live nginx cipher list for the public TLS termination of axislab.top — elliptic-curve DH key agreement, Shor-broken. This is the repo's highest-priority harvest-now-decrypt-later surface; traffic captured today is decryptable once quantum hardware matures.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live ssl_protocols directive (TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3) read in full at infrastructure/nginx/conf.d/ssl.conf:6; included by foundry-ssl.conf into the 443 server block.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is used pervasively: non-security purposes (cache keys, dedup fingerprints, rollout bucketing with PHASE3_BUNDLE_ROLLOUT_SALT) and security purposes — hashing password-reset tokens (password-reset.service.ts:178), email-verification codes (:295), opaque tokens, WeChat OAuth state, and AES key derivation in aes-adapter.ts:113/117. Sound digest, Grover square-root only; not urgent.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption for LLM/embedding API keys at rest: EncryptionManager wrapper with algorithm literal 'aes-256-gcm' at every site (security-config.ts:101 env default, aes-adapter.ts:28/33, gateway encryption.service.ts:44-45, llm-keys/embedding-models services, import scripts, docker-compose.dev.yml:184 default). PQ-acceptable symmetric AE; quantum concern is only the RSA-OAEP alternative adapter.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA256 signs webhook payloads (webhook.service hmacSha256Hex helper :425-426 used for expectedSignature :272; forwarder signs outgoing requests :109) and derives/verifies CSRF tokens (csrf.service.ts:24/52). Grover-only quantum impact; secrets arrive via env — see the hardcoded fallback findings for the weakness in that supply.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDHE-*-AES128-GCM suites are permitted in the live nginx cipher list — 128-bit AES leaves only 64-bit security under Grover, below the 112-bit classical floor for national-security baselines.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 in GCM: same key-at-rest encryption surface as the AES-GCM object plus the AES256-GCM TLS suites in the nginx cipher list (ssl.conf:7). Grover leaves a 128-bit margin — the strongest symmetric posture in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CHACHA20-POLY1305 suites in the live nginx cipher list — sound symmetric AE over a classical key exchange.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed .env templates carry real-format default credentials: postgres/postgres (postgres/.env:8,16), admin/admin123 (messaging/.env:5,16), and consul token empty with ACL disabled (consul/.env:19-24,37). The same defaults repeat in deployment compose files (docker-compose.yml:165 DB_PASSWORD:-postgres, docker-compose.dev.yml:55 Grafana admin). Changeable here: rotate and source from a secrets manager; treat every deployed default as burned.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl is declared transitively (pnpm-lock); it ships XSalsa20-Poly1305 AE, X25519 DH and Ed25519 signatures — the key-agreement and signature parts are Shor-vulnerable. No direct call site found in application code; presence is what the dependency inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jsonwebtoken 9.0.2 drives all JWT signing/verification in gateway auth (token.service.ts) with HS256; also declared in infrastructure/security/package.json. Shared-secret JWT: any verifier can mint.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT signing capability via jsonwebtoken@9.0.2 declared at apps/gateway/package.json — same logical asset as the jsonwebtoken library object; reference that entry rather than this one.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jws@3.2.3 is the transitive dependency under jsonwebtoken that performs the JWS compact serialization every JWT mint relies on; its HMAC-SHA256 path carries the HS256 signing.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt@5.1.1 declared at apps/gateway/package.json:58 — same logical asset as the bcrypt hashing-adapter object (ALG-2384a3f4); reference that entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live ssl_certificate reference for the axislab.top HTTPS server (foundry-ssl.conf:7, mounted at /etc/nginx/ssl/cert.pem from infrastructure/nginx/ssl). The certificate bytes are NOT committed in this tree (grep found no BEGIN CERTIFICATE) — the reference is observable here, the material is managed outside the repo; its key type (RSA vs ECDSA) decides which of the confirmed ECDHE-ECDSA/ECDHE-RSA suites can actually negotiate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live ssl_certificate_key reference (foundry-ssl.conf:9, /etc/nginx/ssl/key.pem) — the private key path of the public TLS server. Key file not committed in the tree (good), but the mount source infrastructure/nginx/ssl must be access-controlled and rotated; whoever holds this key terminates the ECDHE sessions confirmed in the ssl.conf objects.
